video_mp4.label: MP4 Source
video_mp4.description: Upload or enter URL of MP4 video file

start_time.label: Start Time (in seconds)
start_time.description: Set the time when the video should start playing

end_time.description: Set the time when the video should stop playing (0 for end)
end_time.label: End Time (in seconds)

playback_speed.label: Playback Speed (Advanced)
playback_speed.description: Set the default playback speed of the video.

lazy_loading.label: Lazy Loading
lazy_loading.description: Load video only when it comes into view

aspect_ratio.label: Aspect Ratio
aspect_ratio.description: If enabled, displays the video title above the player.

autoplay.label: Autoplay
autoplay.description: When enabled, the video will start playing automatically when the page loads.Not working with dailymotion source

play_on_viewport.label: Play on Viewport
play_on_viewport.description: Video will start playing when it enters the viewport

viewport_offset.label: Offset from Top
viewport_offset.description: Offset distance from top of viewport (px)

viewport_offset_bottom.label: Offset from Bottom
viewport_offset_bottom.description: Offset distance from bottom of viewport (px)

show_controls.label: Video Player Controls
show_controls.description: Shows or hides the video player controls.

mute.label: Mute Video
mute.description: When enabled, the video will be muted by default.

loop.label: Loop Video
loop.description: When enabled, the video will play continuously in a loop.

sticky_video.label: Sticky Video
sticky_video.description: When enabled, the video will stick to a corner of the screen when scrolled past.

sticky_video_position.label: Sticky Position
sticky_video_position.description: Choose which corner the video sticks to.

sticky_video_width.label: Sticky Width
sticky_video_width.description: Width of the sticky video in pixels.

sticky_video_offset_x.label: Horizontal Offset
sticky_video_offset_x.description: Horizontal distance from the screen edge in px/%.

sticky_video_offset_y.label: Vertical Offset
sticky_video_offset_y.description: Vertical distance from the screen edge in px/%.

sticky_video_z_index.label: Z-Index
sticky_video_z_index.description: Stack order of the sticky video.

sticky_video_close_button.label: Close Button
sticky_video_close_button.description: Show a close button on the sticky video.

sticky_video_on_mobile.label: Show Sticky on Mobile
sticky_video_on_mobile.description: When enabled, sticky video will also be active on mobile devices.

show_title.label: Video Title
show_title.description: If enabled, displays the video title above the player.
